title: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter

stops.title: Photoelectric effect & experimental observations
stops.inShort: Emission of electrons from a metal surface when light of frequency ν ≥ ν₀ (threshold frequency) is incident. Stopping potential V₀ measures K_max = e V₀. Photocurrent ∝ intensity; K_max depends only on frequency, not intensity.

stops.title: Einstein's photoelectric equation & photocell
stops.inShort: Light consists of photons of energy E = hν. Einstein's equation: hν = φ₀ + K_max = hν₀ + eV₀, where φ₀ = hν₀ is work function. Slope of V₀ vs ν graph is h/e.

stops.title: De Broglie hypothesis & Davisson-Germer experiment
stops.inShort: Every moving particle has an associated matter wave of wavelength λ = h/p = h/(mv) = h/√(2mK). For electron accelerated through V volts: λ = 1.227 / √V nm. Davisson-Germer experiment verified electron diffraction.

items.f: h ν = φ₀ + K_max = h ν₀ + e V₀
items.s: φ₀ = h ν₀ = h c / λ₀ is work function.

items.f: λ = h / p = h / √(2 m K) = 1.227 / √V nm (electron)

board.text: An electron, a proton, an α-particle and a hydrogen atom are moving with the same kinetic energy. The associated de-Broglie wavelength will be longest for ____.
board.answer: (b) electron (since λ = h/√(2mK) ⇒ λ ∝ 1/√m, and electron has the smallest mass).

board.text: State Einstein's photoelectric equation and explain any two characteristics of photoelectric effect on its basis.
board.answer:
Einstein's photoelectric equation: hν = φ₀ + K_max = hν₀ + ½ m v_max².
1. Threshold frequency: If ν < ν₀, K_max becomes negative, which is impossible; hence no photoemission occurs below ν₀ regardless of intensity.
2. Instantaneous emission: A single photon transfers its entire energy hν to one electron in a single elastic-like collision, so emission occurs without time lag.
